coordination.note: No unusual experiment is claimed. This is deterministic hardening of the existing qwen35-jlens admission path after a concrete upstream runtime falsifier was identified.

external_primary_evidence.observed_defect: Qwen3.5 AutoModelForCausalLM could silently ignore a concrete dtype while unwrapping the composite checkpoint into the text-only model path.
external_primary_evidence.reason_for_runtime_observation: An upstream fix does not prove the exact installed runtime or exact loaded weighted bytes. Clay runtime admission therefore observes actual loaded module dtypes instead of inferring them from a request or package label.

laws: weighted forward and bounded Jacobian phases record actual loaded weight dtype samples before J-Space credit

a supported concrete dtype request must match every sampled loaded module or fail closed
unsupported concrete dtype labels fail closed rather than receiving precision credit
delta.authority: No new truth authority, model authority, J-Space authority, GWT authority, effect path or receipt authority was introduced.

covered: official qwen3_5_text model type remains required
old composite model type expectation remains rejected
